capabilities: Animate an accretion disk with GLSL shaders
Show a dashboard with clock, stats, and recent notes
Highlight a note's links on hover and open it on click
Rank notes by link degree and detect project folders
extras: Respects reduced-motion settings by skipping the infall animation, supports 11 interface languages, and steps graphics quality down when frames drop; built on three.js.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view is flat and static, offering no immersive, spatial way to explore how notes connect.
summary: 3D note graph that renders notes as stars orbiting an animated black hole, with a live dashboard of vault stats.
